dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped rings exhibit sharp gradient transitions from bright white perimeters to darker gray interiors. The edges are jagged and non-uniform, particularly in the mid-body cluster.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid, high-intensity white blobs located on the far-left anterior section, lacking internal gradients. Core pixel concentration is high in these localized clusters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the central four macro-annuli form a distorted trapezoidal relationship, while a secondary set of centroids toward the posterior forms a near-linear horizontal alignment.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique interconnected chain-link pattern where adjacent macro-annuli share sections of their high-intensity perimeter, creating a tessellated effect in the central flank region.
